notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

An update has been rolled out, addressing a number of script errors found while gathering feedback and viewing content made by the community! 

A big thank you to everyone involved, and especially Youtube Let's Player "Luis-san" for his thorough play-through which helped expose some of these issues!

His play-through can be found here : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SlJlrqFBLA&list=PLachUiHg1hacJvEPT1i4eQRsUV0DfFyGf
